title: Rescue from Fort Neugrad
description: Galmar Stone-Fist sends you to Fort Neugrad to rescue captured Stormcloak soldiers. Meet Ralof's rescue band, sneak through the underwater cave into the prison, free the prisoners, and eliminate the Imperial garrison to claim the fort for the Stormcloaks.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak's second-in-command and coordinate military operations.
Fort Neugrad holds captured Stormcloak brothers who must be freed.
I have scouts already positioned near Fort Neugrad awaiting orders.

MEET_STORMCLOAKS: I have sent the rescue party to Fort Neugrad. The player must meet Ralof near the fort.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Fort Neugrad has fallen to Stormcloak forces and our captured brothers walk free.
Siddgeir has been deposed as Jarl of Falkreath; Dengeir of Stuhn's Ravine now rules the hold in our name.
Falkreath Hold belongs to the Stormcloaks, securing our southern flank for the campaigns ahead.
The soldier who took Neugrad has proven their worth and will be needed for what comes next.

base_facts: I lead the Stormcloak rescue band scouting Fort Neugrad.
There is a cave beneath the lake that leads into the fort's prison.
Once the prisoners are freed, my men and I will join the fight in the courtyard.

FREE_PRISONERS: The prisoners have been freed from their cells and are ready to fight.
TAKE_OVER_FORT: The fort is ours. I will stay behind and clean up the mess.
REPORT_TO_RALOF: The mission is complete. Fort Neugrad belongs to the Stormcloaks now.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Fort Neugrad is firmly in Stormcloak hands and I am staying to garrison the position.
The prisoners we freed fought alongside us to claim the courtyard; they live and are armed once more.
Siddgeir's reign in Falkreath is ended; Dengeir now sits as Jarl.
The player carried the day at Neugrad and should carry word of our victory onward.

beats.comment: Player receives orders from Galmar and goes to meet the rescue party near Fort Neugrad.
Player sneaks into the fort through the underwater cave or assaults the front gate.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player sneaks into the fort through the underwater cave or assaults the front gate.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player sneaks into the fort through the underwater cave or assaults the front gate.

beats.comment: Player frees the Stormcloak prisoners in the fort prison using the prison key from Imperial soldiers.
Player eliminates the Imperial garrison. Ralof's band joins the fight in the courtyard.
Player reports back to Ralof after the fort is taken. Ralof says he will stay and clean up.
Quest completes. Fort Neugrad is taken, prisoners rescued, Siddgeir deposed and Dengeir installed as Jarl of Falkreath.
